connector.name: Telemem
connector.registryDescription: Long-term and multimodal memory for AI agents - character-aware, mem0-compatible, fully-local option
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package telemem. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the teleai-uagi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the default OpenAI LLM/embedder (not needed with a local TELEMEM_CONFIG)

env.name: TELEMEM_CONFIG
env.description: Path to a TeleMem YAML/JSON config, e.g. the fully-local Ollama + FAISS setup (config/config.ollama.yaml)

env.name: TELEMEM_DEFAULT_USER_ID
env.description: Default memory scope when tool calls omit user_id/agent_id/run_id (default: telemem-mcp)
